title: Action
description: One capability of one entity: what it takes, what it returns, whether it changes anything, whether it reaches outside DNA, and the state change it makes, if any. An Action is complete enough to be a tool, so every surface that calls it (an agent, a person, an HTTP client, a test) is derived from it and none is written by hand. Its input and output fields are attributes, never states. A read-only Action has no transition.

id.description: Kebab-case. Unique among the Actions of its behaviour document.

entity.description: The entity this is a capability of.

description.description: What the Action does and when to use it. A derived tool's description is this text.

external.description: Reaches outside DNA: a payment, a message, a webhook, a third party. Refused before a sandbox is claimed. Defaults to false.

transition.description: The state change the Action makes on its entity's state attribute. Without from, the Action creates an instance in to.

from.description: The states the Action may start from.

entityRef.description: An entity id in the described domain, or domain/entity for an entity declared in a domain it uses.

field.description: One field of the contract, as an attribute. A state is not a field.
